open_points.subject: plan_run mapped-node conclusion when its list has not been delivered
open_points.text: a skipped_by_guard or upstream_failed record, which runs writes only for a node none of whose elements executed, concludes the whole node so at once, mapped or not — the rule that a mapped node concludes only when every element concluded is for a node whose elements execute —, a function node and an operation node alike
open_points.other_text: a mapped node whose list has not been delivered has no element, has not concluded and is not ready
open_points.question: Must a mapped node with no delivered list nevertheless conclude when it has a skipped_by_guard or upstream_failed node-level record, or must the new absolute statement be restricted to mapped nodes without such a record?
